name: oddvale-games
description: games.oddvale.com: the hub that lists and hosts Oddvale's AI-made browser games.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run check && node scripts/cf.mjs pages deploy dist --project-name oddvale-games --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.api:dev: cd api && npx wrangler d1 execute oddvale-games-api --local --file schema.sql && npx wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.api:db:init: cd api && node ../scripts/cf.mjs d1 execute oddvale-games-api --remote --file schema.sql
scripts.api:deploy: npm run api:test && cd api && node ../scripts/cf.mjs deploy
